# PROJ-9203 — plan PLANONLYMARKER

This directory holds a plan and nothing else: no intake.json, no fix.json, no pr-followups.md.
A feature loop that stopped after planning still learned something, and a directory whose only
artifact is prose must still be recognised as a run directory.

## The strategy that was picked
Split the cadence reader out of the grid so the monthly tab stops borrowing the weekly offset.
